title: MongoDB connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One MongoDB instance's settings, read by the native MongoDB family (`loams_connector_mongodb::mongodb`, CN2 Task 16) over its own wire-protocol client (R16.1). The keys are the guide's table (docs/guides/connectors/mongodb.md). Hosts are names, never a connection URI (a URI could carry credentials). `password`, `tls.cert` and `tls.key` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`. Naming `collection` makes the instance a sink.

hosts.description: The seed list, as `host` or `host:port` (port 27017 when omitted).

host.description: One seed, `host` or `host:port`; `hosts` is the list form.

replica_set.description: Fail unless the server is a member of this replica set.

database.description: The database to read or write.

password.description: SCRAM-SHA-256's password. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

auth_source.description: The database that holds the user (`$external` for MONGODB-X509).

auth_mechanism.description: `SCRAM-SHA-256` (`basic`; the default when `username` is set) or `MONGODB-X509` (`mtls`, with `tls.cert` and `tls.key`).

tls.description: `true` for TLS with the webpki roots, or an object. `cert` and `key` go together.

ca_pem.description: Extra CA roots, as PEM (not a secret).

cert.description: The client certificate chain (PEM), for MONGODB-X509. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

key.description: The client private key (PEM), for MONGODB-X509. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

server_name.description: The name the server certificate is checked against, when not the host's.

mode.description: Sources: `batch` reads each collection once at one cluster time (`document`, Arrow); `cdc` takes a snapshot, then follows a change stream (`change`, `schema-change`).

collections.description: Sources: the collections to read; every collection in `database` when omitted.

max_splits.description: Batch: up to this many `_id` ranges per collection.

split_rows.description: Batch: one range per this many documents.

snapshot.description: CDC: `initial` reads every collection at the stream's start time first; `never` starts with the stream.

full_document.description: CDC: the change stream's fullDocument option.

before_change.description: CDC: pre-images (MongoDB 6.0+, with changeStreamPreAndPostImages on the collection).

heartbeat_ms.description: CDC: how often an idle stream checkpoints its token.

await_ms.description: CDC: how long a getMore waits, in milliseconds.

window_ms.description: CDC: how often the oplog window is sampled.

collection.description: Sinks: the target collection. Naming it makes the instance a sink.

write.description: Sinks: `upsert` replaces the document matching `key` (and deletes on loamsop = d), `insert` inserts.

key.description: Sinks: the upsert key, the fields a document is matched on (dotted paths allowed). Declared because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true.

transactional.description: Sinks: exactly once, each batch in one multi-document transaction with the instance's document in `checkpoint_collection` (replica sets; a standalone server writes the batch, then the checkpoint).

checkpoint_collection.description: Sinks: where the checkpoint lives, in `database`.

evolution.description: The schema evolution policy (see the schema-mapping guide).

lossy.description: Conversions allowed to lose information, by path (for example Arrow `Timestamp(ns)` written as a BSON date).
